title: Three Tankers Struck by Unknown Projectiles in Strait of Hormuz
detail: Three commercial tankers were struck by unknown projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz, marking a fresh escalation of attacks on commercial shipping in the strategic waterway. The incidents underscore the continuing vulnerability of vessel traffic transiting the critical chokepoint, through which roughly 20% of global oil trade flows.

title: Indian Refiners Shift to Direct Hormuz Transit as Shipping Industry Adapts
detail: Indian oil refiners are adapting their shipping strategy, hiring tankers to transit the Strait of Hormuz directly rather than taking longer rerouting alternatives. The tactical shift reflects the shipping industry's adaptation to ongoing disruption in the strategic waterway, balancing risk against the higher costs of extended Cape-route alternatives.
